games.name: HUSH [Zombie Extraction]
games.desc:
🔓 OPEN BETA: expect bugs and changes. Join our community for news and feedback (Social Links below).

🤫 HUSH: Stillwater is under quarantine. The infected can't see, but they hear everything.

Drop into the town with up to 3 friends, loot what you can and reach an exit before the clock runs out. Die inside and you lose everything you brought. Only your secure case comes home.

🔫 Every shot rings the dinner bell. Sneak, close doors, use a blade, or go loud and run.
🎒 Grid inventory, stash and a hideout you build up between raids
🧟 Runners, Brutes, Screamers, blind Listeners, pager Ringers, shielded Riot cops and more, plus 5 bosses
📼 Trader jobs and lost tapes reveal what the MX-11 trial did to this town
⚙️ Normal, Hard and Nightmare raids, up to 12 survivors per raid, pure PvE

Stay quiet. Get out.
